flags: minor: distractors are weak; 'devoid' is the only real trap (contrast with 'empty') and it fails grammatically with 'with life'; 'reminiscent' and 'wary' are clearly off-topic
S001-01.notes: 'Expected empty, but it was ___ with life' plus the colon elaboration (ferns crowded, vines climbed) calls for 'teeming'.

flags: minor: C says the foundation 'matters more than its span'; the text says the foundation is 'the most important part', so that is a small inference, but a fair one
S001-02.notes: The quotation restates Reyes's claim vividly. A is wrong because it is Reyes's own view, not a counterargument. B and D are not in the text.

flags: minor: Text 2 never explicitly grants that list memorization raises quiz scores. 'Definitions memorized for a quiz' implies it, so B holds up.
S001-03.notes: Text 2 is about how long words are retained, not how fast they are learned. D is the main trap, because Text 2 makes no speed claim. C is too extreme ('cannot learn any'). A is not supported.

S001-04.notes: B covers both points: less waste and residents learning. A is too narrow, C contradicts 'for free', and D makes a comparison the text never makes.

flags: minor: the key is the only choice that compares all three values and is much longer than the others, so the answer is easy to spot
S001-05.notes: Only A compares sunflower with both other foods. The table math checks out: 212+87+145=444, so C is accurate but irrelevant.

S001-06.notes: The chain of shell swaps means several crabs upgrade. B is contradicted ('and so on down the line'), C is contradicted (they line up by size), and A has no support. The science is consistent with documented hermit crab vacancy chains.

S001-07.notes: There are two independent clauses. A is a comma splice and C is a run-on. D, 'which within ten years, the number...had tripled', leaves the relative clause ungrammatical. Only the semicolon works, and I found no second grammatical option.

S001-08.notes: The singular subject 'collection' is separated from the verb by a nonrestrictive clause that contains plural nouns. A, B and D are all plural forms, so 'offers' is the only option that agrees.

S001-09.notes: Coquí frogs are a contrast to most frogs, so 'however' fits. The fact checks out: coquí (Eleutherodactylus) develop directly on land with no tadpole stage.

flags: minor: D is the only choice that mentions both materials with a contrast word; A and C state a similarity, which makes the item very easy
S001-10.notes: The goal is a difference. D contrasts unlimited recycling of glass with the few cycles plastic can go through.
